_readme: Edit this file to update business details. Empty strings are hidden on the site. After changing siteUrl, run `npm run build` so every QR code points at the new domain. SEO: paste the Search Console code into googleSiteVerification, your Google Business Profile link into googleBusinessUrl, exact map coordinates into geo, and opening hours into openingHours as {"days":["Monday","Tuesday"],"opens":"11:00","closes":"21:00"}. See docs/seo.md.
name: MEON
tagline: Instant noodles from across Asia, cooked your way.
hoursNote: Opening hours are posted on our Instagram, @meonnoodles. Please check before you visit.
orderingNote: Walk in, choose a packet and cook it your way. Dine in or take it away.
